opening.argument: The opportunity is presented as a cryptocurrency venture where participation, token activity, and recruitment are tied to financial gain. OneCoin is introduced as a chance to participate in a new currency, while education packages provide trading tokens for exchange activity and potential profit. The structure then links bonus qualification to becoming an active marketing partner and building a sales team, making team-building central to the promised rewards. The pitch adds urgency through a limited launch phase, claims that the split program can double a token portfolio, and urges viewers to register while presenting cryptocurrency profit as a future opportunity. Together, these features promote paid participation and recruitment commissions through a tiered structure.
